messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's TF workspace rename, gpu-pool scale-up in eu-west-1 started failing. Launches error with KMS denied. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
ryan: yup saw alerts at 03:12 UTC. looking like the module's kms_key_alias var got renamed to kms_alias_name in the last module bump (v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0). GitOps applied it automatically.
infra-bot: CI-CD: terraform-apply job failed on prod-eu (eu-west-1) — error: "AccessDenied: KMS:Decrypt" when attaching instance profile. See run: https://ci.internal/runs/12345
anna: oof. that explains why the instance init fails and autoscaler can't bring nodes up. can we inject the old alias name as fallback in the module? :thinking:
tom: quick mitigation: patch the module to accept both var names via shim: add kms_key_alias variable (deprecated) that maps to kms_alias_name if present. then roll a canary to eu-west-1 only.
jen: watch out for state drift — the workspace rename changed variable key in tfvars; some workspaces in other regions still using old tfstate layout. we should lock before apply and run plan checks.
sre-oncall: added alert for "gpu-pool: failed node boots" and ramping cost spike — autoscaler kept retrying, so we already ran ~20 failed launches => cost noise. paused autoscale for affected pools.
devops-ci: paste of the failing log:
```
Error: Error launching instance: InvalidAMIID.NotFound: The image id '[ami-0abc123]' does not exist
caused by: PermissionError: KMS Decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:1234:key/....
Request ID: abcdef-1234
```
ryan: plan: 1) patch module with backwards-compat shim; 2) create gitops PR targeting eu region only; 3) run tf plan against eu workspace and approve; 4) revert autoscaler pause when nodes boot. canary -> 2-3 instances.
maya: agree. also file a small postmortem on how module renames propagate through gitops (cc @eng-platform). can we add a module-compatibility checklist to releases?
anna: I'll open the PR and include release note to prompt teams to check workspace variable names. tagging eng-releases for future module deprecation windows. :hammer:
jen: also recommend adding a tfvalidate hook in CI to catch missing variables across workspaces before applying.
infra-bot: Note: terraform module v2.5.0 was promoted at 2026-03-17T22:10Z
sre-oncall: thanks — re-enabling autoscale in 30m if canary passes. will monitor.
maya: thanks everyone — ping if you need help with IAM policies. I'll draft the postmortem skeleton.
